§8§o◆ History

§0Ravenkraft began as
§0a handful of farms on
§0the shore of a cold
§0lake. The first
§0settlers built in
§0spruce and cobble,
§0and they argued
§0about everything -
§0the shape of the
§0harbour, the height of
§0the walls, the name of
§0the town itself.

§0Records from that
§0time are thin; most
§0were lost when the
§0archive flooded.

§0What survives tells of
§0a council of seven, a
§0bell that rang at
§0every dusk, and a
§0long feud with the
§0miners of the eastern
§0ridge. The feud ended
§0with a wedding, or so
§0the songs claim. The

§0bell still hangs in the
§0old tower, cracked but
§0unbowed, and the
§0council still meets on
§0the first day of each
§0season to read the
§0names of the
§0founders aloud.
